column3: Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “truth,” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they have broken out” is rendered “They break all restraint,” and “blood touches blood” “bloodshed upon bloodshed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it will dry up” (or “mourn”) is rendered “will mourn,” and “wither” “waste away.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they lift up its desire to their iniquity” is rendered “They set their heart on their iniquity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will visit on him” is rendered “I will punish them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they have forsaken Yahweh to keep” is rendered “they have ceased obeying the LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; “takes away the heart” is rendered “enslave the heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “by his wood” is rendered “from their wooden idols,” and “from under their God” “against their God.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the cult prostitutes” is rendered as singular, “a ritual harlot,” and “will be ruined” “will be trampled.”
Close to the Hebrew; “let not Judah become guilty” is rendered “Let not Judah offend.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a stubborn heifer” is rendered “a stubborn calf,” and “will pasture them” “will let them forage.”
NKJV renders “their drink has come to an end (turned sour)” as “Their drink is rebellion,” and “her shields love shame” as “Her rulers dearly love dishonor”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
